summary: Imported Ghost posts no longer point search engines at broken Ghost preview links as their canonical address.
detailed_changes: Canonical links that still contained Ghost's placeholder address are removed, so those articles use their own Newsroom address instead (#556).
Staff can save those posts again without a canonical URL error, and future Ghost imports skip such links (#556).
affected_areas: User groups affected: readers and search engines; staff editing imported posts
Public impact: correct canonical links on imported articles
Internal impact: one-off migration clears placeholder canonical URLs on posts and pages
